summary: Added literal rootCmd.AddCommand(...) lines in root.go for the hand-written commands.
reason: The commands are also registered by the init() hook in nccpl_register.go, which is what preserves the wiring across `generate --force`. But the press's scorecard reachability walk seeds only from literal AddCommand arguments in root.go, so 11 of 12 hand-written commands were invisible to the entire scorecard, dead-code analysis, breadth sampling and MCP surface scoring. addNovelCommandIfAbsent is idempotent, so listing them here as well changes no runtime behaviour (--help output is byte-identical) and keeps the reprint-survival property intact.
validated_outcome: insight 2/10 -> 10/10, workflows 6/10 -> 10/10; `--help` byte-identical, no command registered twice.
